name: OBD: read readiness / MIL status (mode 01 PID 01)
description: Read-only. Monitor status since DTCs cleared: byte A bit 7 = MIL on, bits 0-6 = DTC count; bytes B-D = which readiness monitors are supported and which are still incomplete. Defaults to OBD ECU #1 (0x7E0/0x7E8, ISO 15765-4); enter another ECU's ids in the Target fields to address it instead.
